stories.title: GTA 6 is finally out, and Jason takes his dog jet skiing
stories.summary: Thirteen years after GTA 5, the game unlocked in New Zealand at midnight and gameplay flooded X while America waited for 9 p.m. Pacific. The clip everyone shared: Jason on a jet ski, his dog in goggles and a life vest.

stories.title: xQc spends his first 45 minutes of GTA 6 renovating a house
stories.summary: With the whole internet watching streams, xQc skipped the heists and went straight to interior design.

stories.title: You can now order McDonald's through Discord
stories.summary: A new Discord feature lets you order McDonald's without leaving a call, timed for a night when everyone planned to stay on the couch.
